gitCommit.subject: chore(claude): fire graphify nudge once per session, not every tool call (#383)
gitCommit.body:
chore(claude): fire graphify nudge once per session, not every tool call (#383)

* chore(claude): fire graphify nudge once per session, not every tool call

The PreToolUse graphify hooks re-injected a "MANDATORY" reminder before
every grep/find Bash call and every source Read/Glob — hundreds of times
per long session. Move the logic into .claude/hooks/graphify-nudge.py and
gate it on a per-session marker so it fires once; CLAUDE.md already
carries the standing graphify rule.
